
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/rockey627/p/22831561" title="发布于 2026-09-03 23:08">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">AScript之编译递归函数</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>AScript是一个开源的C#动态脚本解析执行引擎，支持解释执行和编译执行两种模式，本篇介绍AScript中如何编译脚本中的递归函数。</p>
<h2 id="h_2078923063014462146_0" data-into-catalog-status="">一 解析函数</h2>
<p data-pid="G4AhhbYK">我们先来看个脚本：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> fib(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> n) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (n &lt;= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> n;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> fib(n - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>) + fib(n - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> fib(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p data-pid="JeD0Ym8Z">该脚本定义了一个fib递归函数，然后调用该递归函数，返回函数值。</p>
<p data-pid="9IH-61vJ">解析脚本时，将函数定义生成语法树<code>DefineFuncNode</code>：</p>
<ul>
<li data-pid="iEJN1sxN">函数名：fib</li>
<li data-pid="S7asLhC7">返回类型：int</li>
<li data-pid="sK_5dbJS">参数列表：int n</li>
<li data-pid="DfRzfDgH">函数体</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="h_2078923063014462146_1" data-into-catalog-status="">二 编译函数</h2>
<p data-pid="N9xg6BV_">对<code>DefineFuncNode</code>进行编译时，我们并不需要提前知道它的函数体是否存在递归调用。</p>
<h3 id="h_2078923063014462146_2" data-into-catalog-status="">2.1 编译上下文</h3>
<p data-pid="7nxJkSk1">首先，有个编译上下文<code>BuildContext</code>，保存编译期间的变量定义、函数定义。</p>
<p data-pid="_dAnMtRj">编译函数时先定义一个临时上下文，用于保存函数内部的变量定义和函数定义：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> tempBuildContext = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> BuildContext(buildContext)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span>     RewriteLocalVariables = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span>     ReturnType =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> funcReturnType,
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span>     IsMain = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> };</pre>
</div>
<h3 id="h_2078923063014462146_3" data-into-catalog-status="">2.2 函数参数</h3>
<p data-pid="3Op1_xO3">向临时上下文添加参数定义：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> Type[] argTypes = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.Args != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span> &amp;&amp; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.Args.Length &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span>     argTypes = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Type[<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.Args.Length];
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> i = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>; i &lt; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.Args.Length; i++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> arg = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.Args[i];
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> type = arg.SystemType ??<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> scriptContext.EvalType(arg.Type);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (type == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ScriptAnalyzingException($<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">unknown parameter type {arg.Type} in function {this.Name}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span>         argTypes[i] =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> type;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> argName =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> arg.Name;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 匿名参数名：_1、_2、_3 ...</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (IsAnonymous(argName)) argName = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">_</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> i;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span>         tempBuildContext.Parameters[argName] =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Expression.Parameter(type, argName);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span> }</pre>
</div>
<h3 id="h_2078923063014462146_4" data-into-catalog-status="">2.3 函数头定义</h3>
<p data-pid="0lBjOlAu">这一步非常关键，先保存函数头定义，后续编译函数体时如果有函数调用，首先会搜索函数头定义列表是否有匹配的函数，实现递归调用。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 匿名函数不生成函数头定义</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> delegateDefine = IsAnonymous(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.Name) ? <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span> : buildContext.AddDelegateDefine(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.Name, argTypes, funcReturnType);</pre>
</div>
<p data-pid="6QqQMEI-">注意，函数定义要添加到全局<code>buildContext</code>上下文，而不是函数临时上下文<code>tempBuildContext</code>中。</p>
<p data-pid="TWcEm-Tj">我们来看一下<code>AddDelegateDefine</code>方法：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> DelegateDefine AddDelegateDefine(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> name, Type[] argTypes, Type returnType)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>     List&lt;DelegateDefine&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> list;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (_DelegateDefines == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>         _DelegateDefines = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Dictionary&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>, List&lt;DelegateDefine&gt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>         _DelegateDefines[name] = list = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> List&lt;DelegateDefine&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!_DelegateDefines.TryGetValue(name, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> list))
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>         _DelegateDefines[name] = list = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> List&lt;DelegateDefine&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> delegateDefine = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DelegateDefine(name, argTypes, returnType);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    list.Add(delegateDefine);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> delegateDefine;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p>函数头<code>DelegateDefine</code>定义如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> int fib(int n)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DelegateDefine
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Name { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> Type[] ArgTypes { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> Type ReturnType { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> ParameterExpression Variable { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> DelegateDefine(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> name, Type[] argTypes, Type returnType)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.Name =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> name;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.ArgTypes =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> argTypes;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.ReturnType =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> returnType;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p data-pid="38YWCfyb">其中<code>Variable</code>字段有什么用途呢？</p>
<p data-pid="pf_eVnrK">它的类型是ParameterExpression，很明显是一个变量，用于引用编译的函数LambdaExpression，那什么时候创建这个变量呢？</p>
<h3 id="h_2078923063014462146_5" data-into-catalog-status="">2.4 编译函数体</h3>
<p data-pid="xTBR0znf">前面函数参数定义、函数头定义都已就绪，接下来开始编译函数体：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> body = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.Body.Build(tempBuildContext, scriptContext, buildOptions);</pre>
</div>
<p>我们具体看看函数体中调用函数是如何编译的，调用函数<code>fib(n - 1)</code>会解析生成CallFuncNode语法树：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CallFuncNode : TreeNode
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Name { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> ITreeNode[] Args { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span>     
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Expression Build(BuildContext buildContext, ScriptContext scriptContext, BuildOptions options);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">7</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p>编译时会搜索上下文中的函数定义：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> Expression[] argExprs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> Type[] argTypes = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 从编译上下文环境中构建</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> tempBuildContext =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> buildContext;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> (tempBuildContext != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = BuildFunc(buildContext, options, tempBuildContext.TempFunctions, name, args, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ref</span> argExprs, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ref</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> argTypes);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (result != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> result;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (tempBuildContext.HasDelegateDefine(name))
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (args != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span> &amp;&amp; args.Count &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> &amp;&amp; argExprs == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span>             argExprs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Expression[args.Count];
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span>             argTypes = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Type[args.Count];
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> i = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>; i &lt; args.Count; i++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span>                 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> arg = args[i].Build(buildContext, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, options);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span>                 argExprs[i] =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> arg;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span>                 argTypes[i] =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> arg.Type;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">21</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">22</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> del =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> tempBuildContext.GetDelegateDefine(name, argTypes);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">24</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (del != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">25</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">26</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Expression.Invoke(del, argExprs);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">27</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">28</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">29</span>     tempBuildContext =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> tempBuildContext.Parent;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">30</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p>前面调用<code>AddDelegateDefine</code>添加函数定义，这里<code>GetDelegateDefine</code>获取匹配的函数定义：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> ParameterExpression GetDelegateDefine(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> name, IList&lt;Type&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> inArgTypes)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (_DelegateDefines == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span> || _DelegateDefines.Count == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!_DelegateDefines.TryGetValue(name, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> list)) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (list.Count == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> delegateDefine = list.FirstOrDefault(a =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ScriptUtils.IsMatchArgTypes(inArgTypes, a.ArgTypes));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (delegateDefine == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (delegateDefine.Variable == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>         delegateDefine.Variable = Expression.Variable(ScriptUtils.GetDelegateType(delegateDefine.ArgTypes, delegateDefine.ReturnType ?? <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)), delegateDefine.Name);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> delegateDefine.Variable;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p data-pid="7cS6cXhX">匹配到对应的函数定义时，创建DelegateDefine中的Variable变量，就表示有递归调用了。</p>
<h3 id="h_2078923063014462146_6" data-into-catalog-status="">2.5 生成Lambda</h3>
<p data-pid="J6k37zJQ">前面我们在编译函数体中的调用函数语句时，会检索当前函数定义，来实现递归调用。</p>
<p data-pid="7cEgVr0R">最后，就是编译生成完整的函数：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 如果函数未定义返回类型，但是有递归调用，此时无法自动根据函数体推导返回类型，强制定义为object类型</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (funcReturnType == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span> &amp;&amp; delegateDefine?.Variable != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span>     tempBuildContext.ReturnType = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 生成LambdaExpression</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> lambda =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> tempBuildContext.Build(scriptContext, buildOptions, body);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 将函数赋值给临时函数变量</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> tmpVar = delegateDefine?.Variable ??<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Expression.Variable(lambda.Type);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> assign =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Expression.Assign(tmpVar, lambda);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> hashCode =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> tmpVar.GetHashCode();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> tmpVarName = hashCode &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> ? $<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">&lt;&gt;$tmpVar_{hashCode}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> : $<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">&lt;&gt;$tmpVar__{-hashCode}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> buildContext.Variables[tmpVarName] =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> tmpVar;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">buildContext.LocalVariables.Add(tmpVarName);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> buildContext.PrevExpressions.Add(assign);</pre>
</div>
<h3 id="h_2078923063014462146_7" data-into-catalog-status="">2.6 回写函数</h3>
<p data-pid="lATkUVvG">最后的最后，将函数添加到上下文，并回写到ScriptContext中，用于后续脚本调用：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!IsAnonymous(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.Name))
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 添加到编译上下文</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span>     buildContext.AddTempFunc(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.Name, tmpVar);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 回写到脚本上下文</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (buildContext.RewriteLocalVariables &amp;&amp; (options?.RewriteFunctions ?? <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span>) &amp;&amp; !(options?.Standalone ?? <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> addTempFuncExpression =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Expression.Call(
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            buildContext.GetScriptContextParameter(),
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            ScriptUtils.Method_ScriptContext_AddTempFunc,
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>             Expression.Constant(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.Name),
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            tmpVar);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Expression.Block(addTempFuncExpression, tmpVar);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 返回函数引用</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> tmpVar;</pre>
</div>
<h2 id="h_2078923063014462146_8" data-into-catalog-status="">三 编译结果</h2>
<p data-pid="V4h47rzA">我们来看看编译开头的脚本示例是什么样的。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 仅生成LambdaExpression，断点调试可以查看DebugView</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> lambda = script.Lambda(code);</pre>
</div>
<p>查看lambda的DebugView信息：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> .Lambda #Lambda1&lt;System.Func`<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>[AScript.ScriptContext,System.Int32]&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(AScript.ScriptContext $var1) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span>     .Block(System.Func`<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[System.Int32,System.Int32] $fib) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>         $fib = .Lambda #Lambda2&lt;System.Func`<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>[System.Int32,System.Int32]&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        .Call $var1.AddTempFunc(
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>             <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">fib</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            $fib);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>         .Invoke $fib(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> .Lambda #Lambda2&lt;System.Func`<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>[System.Int32,System.Int32]&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(System.Int32 $n) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    .Block(System.Int32 $var2) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span>         .If ($n &lt;= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            .Block() {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span>                 $var2 =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> $n;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                .Return #Label1 { }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        } .Else {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            .Default(System.Void)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">21</span>         $var2 = .Invoke $fib($n - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>) + .Invoke $fib($n - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">22</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        .Return #Label1 { };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        .Label
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">24</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        .LabelTarget #Label1:;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">25</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        $var2
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">26</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">27</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p data-pid="3PjjHCsW">可以看到，首先定义了$fib变量引用fib函数，然后fib函数体调用$fib，实现递归调用。</p>
<h2 id="h_2078923063014462146_9" data-into-catalog-status="">四 结束语</h2>
<p data-pid="6-oKVZM-">通过预先定义函数头的方式，不仅能实现递归调用，也可以实现C语言中的函数头定义功能。如果函数在脚本末尾定义，前面如何发现和调用这个函数呢？我们可以把函数头定义放在最前面，函数实现就可以放后面了。</p>
<p data-pid="EOPBhOka">AScript开源地址：</p>
<ul>
<li data-pid="EOPBhOka"><a title="https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript" href="https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript</a></li>
<li data-pid="EOPBhOka"><a title="https://github.com/rockey627/AScript" href="https://github.com/rockey627/AScript" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/rockey627/AScript</a></li>
</ul>
